title: Metronomad CR 001 Phase 7 — Docs + Acceptance (AGENTS.md + v1 KB-14…KB-17 aligned to as-built, integrity + grep gates, final whole-change-set world-review, timeline close-out)
outcome: Phase 7 (docs + acceptance — no TDD per the phase file) complete for all automated criteria. (1) Loaded exactly the phase file's 'Context to load' (index.md overview/end-state/scope, CR context.md KB-14…KB-17 + D-K + cross-cutting constraints, as-built AGENTS.md, v1 KB list, timeline, CR §1.8/§2.6), then diffed the as-built code against the plan: barrel Analysis exports, lifecycle teardown order, methods (hook, guards, prefill gate, touched-flag sites), index.html template (slider canvas, readout progressbar, hint, KB-6 hooks) — all match; no plan correction needed. (2) Updated Metronomad/AGENTS.md (Architecture: Analysis pure-signal modules, createWaveformView DI-purity + slider replacement, BPM-suggestion contract, playhead rides the 10 Hz songPosition throttle; Directory tree incl. Analysis/, three new test suites, clicks20.wav + make-clicks20-wav.cjs, waveform/tempo specs; Testing: no-real-AudioContext convention for tempo/view suites + clicks20.wav fixture rule + never-assert-its-duration; Conventions: KB-6 hooks extended, the two owned strings, _analysisValid guard discipline, extended beforeUnmount order). (3) Appended KB-14…KB-17 verbatim (with decision date + CR refs) after KB-13 in the v1 plan context.md. (4) Gates: 228/228 unit + 37/37 E2E green; plan-integrity-check OK (63 distinct IDs); rg 'offsetScrubber' → zero hits across index.html test/ MyComponents/ MyESModules/ AGENTS.md; KB-1[4-7] present. (5) Final whole-change-set world-review (subagent): zero action items — every Phase-7 doc claim verified line-by-line against source; cross-cutting risks (peaks GC, canvas backing store, task race, offsetDraft lifecycle, reduced motion, narrow viewport, iOS pointercancel) verified safe; UX-6 double-announcement remains the lone discussion item, already routed to the manual SR checklist. (6) Timeline milestone + trajectory row + phase map updated. Manual acceptance checklist (dual-SR incl. UX-6, real-song tempo accuracy, playback regression by ear, low-end mobile, memory cycles) awaits user sign-off; the commit (build-quick-work) is next.
key_decisions: Docs describe AS-BUILT, verified by spot-reading source before writing (barrel, lifecycle teardown, methods guards/gates, template attrs) — the phase file's 'diff first' rule; the diff found zero plan-vs-code divergence, so no plan correction was needed

Plan-internal conflict resolved in favor of the success criterion: the phase's Changes prose says the Directory note should mention '#offsetScrubber's replacement', but the phase's own Automated success criteria require rg 'offsetScrubber' → zero hits INCLUDING Metronomad/AGENTS.md. The gate wins; AGENTS.md names the replacement token-free ('replaced the old offset range input — the app now has zero input[type=range]'), which also matches E2E-3.10's count-0 assertion
KB-17 in the v1 context.md keeps the historical '#offsetScrubber' reference — that file is outside the grep gate's scope and the reference documents the v1-era precedent the KB is about

Phase 7 marked done in the phase map with an explicit 'manual acceptance checklist pending user sign-off' qualifier rather than a bare ✅ — the plan's own success criteria split automated (met) vs manual (user gate)

world-review prompt scoped to the SHIPPED whole change set with the per-phase review history + pinned-decision list inlined, explicitly asking for (a) doc-vs-code verification of this phase's delta and (b) cross-cutting integration risks no single-phase pass could see — it produced line-by-line doc verification and zero action items

No commit made — per the cross-cutting constraint commits are build-quick-work's responsibility; the phase prepares the commit content (what shipped, the O-1 scrubber removal as the user-visible change, the two new strings)
learnings: Mechanical success-criteria gates (grep passes, integrity checks) can contradict a phase's own prose instructions — run the gates against the PLANNED wording before writing docs; on conflict the success criterion is authoritative and the prose intent is expressed in a token-free form (new learning 2026-08-25-doc-phase-gates-and-double-announced-events.md, §1)

A final whole-change-set world-review — after per-phase reviews were all clean — added real value at near-zero cost by verifying the DOCS (the phase's actual delta) line-by-line against source and checking cross-phase integration surfaces no single-phase review owned (memory across re-loads, task race, draft lifecycle vs state transitions); briefing it with the pinned-decision inventory and prior review history kept it from re-litigating settled decisions

Single event announced through two pinned surfaces (visible role=status hint + live-region announcement) is an emergent a11y property no unit/E2E row can see — it only surfaces in the manual SR pass; the class of issue and the CR-level remedy pattern are now a learning (§2 of the same doc)
